title: Teletherapy Rules and Typical Session Costs by State (2026)
note: PSYPACT status reflects psypact.gov as of July 2026 and covers licensed psychologists only; counselors and social workers have separate compacts still rolling out. Cost ranges are typical self-pay rates for a 45-60 minute individual session compiled from published therapist fee surveys and directory listings; insurance copays are usually far lower. Verify any clinician's license with your state board.

rows.detail: A PSYPACT psychologist based in any member state can legally see you by video, and if you move to another member state you can keep the same psychologist.
PSYPACT law enacted in June 2026; cross-state telepsychology opens once participation takes effect. Until then, a psychologist generally needs a license here to treat you.
